deviations.reason: Legends-context Underworlds warband from the official Battle Profiles PDF (page 65). No accepted source publishes its warscroll rules: Wahapedia carries no page for it and no free official document contains them. Legends content sits outside the current-context intake obligation, so the gap is accepted and tracked rather than blocking; it remains the accepted 2026-08-01b baseline of exactly one profile-only official unit fact.
